info.title: API.SH: H&M
info.description: The H&M API from API.SH: public H&M data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every colour of an H&M product (model) with each size's current online availability in the market (in stock, low on stock, out of stock) and SKU, the colour's price, regular price and ISO currency, and whether any store of the country has the colour. A light call for stock checks. 404 when the product is not sold in that market.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-availability

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An hm.com product link (its locale sets the market). Give this or `id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The article number: 10 digits for one colour (e.g. 1313931001); 7 digits (the model) also work where noted.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market for `id`: en_us (default), en_gb, de_de, de_ch, de_at, fr_fr, sv_se, ...

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: online stock of the market; in_store says whether any store of the country has the colour (sizes per store: /hm/v1/store-availability)

get.description:
Products of one H&M category in one market (locale such as en_us, en_gb, de_de), with sort, facet filters and paging. Each product has the same fields as `/hm/v1/search`: article id, name, brand, price, regular price, currency (ISO code) and sale flag, colour, category, availability, markers, sizes with stock levels, other colours, link, images and `raw`. Also the sort options and facets (each with its filter values, counts and whether it is selected). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. An unknown category answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The site's category id, e.g. `men_tshirtstanks`, `ladies_dresses`, `ladies_jeans`, `men_shoes`.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market and language as in hm.com links: en_us (default), en_gb, de_de, fr_fr, sv_se, ...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), newest, price_asc, price_desc.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet filter `facet:value` from `facets[].values[].value`, e.g. `colorWithNames:black_000000` or `fits:Muscle fit`. Repeat the parameter (or join with `||`) for several, up to 10.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Products per page (default 36, max 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One H&M article by number or link: name, brand, price and regular price with their ISO currency code (e.g. CHF, EUR), sale flag, colour, category, availability, sizes with stock levels and each size's online availability (in stock, low on stock, out of stock) and SKU, whether each colour is in a store of the country, the other colours (article ids, links, images), markers, link, images and production details (countries, suppliers, factories), in the given market.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Article number, e.g. 1359796003.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An hm.com product link (its locale sets the market), instead of `id`.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market for `id`: en_us (default), en_gb, de_de, ...

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The recommendation lists of an H&M product page (style with, alternatives, others also bought ...): each list's id and label with its products (article id, name, price, regular price, ISO currency, sale flag, colour, sizes with stock levels, link and images).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-recommendations

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An hm.com product link (its locale sets the market). Give this or `id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The article number: 10 digits for one colour (e.g. 1313931001); 7 digits (the model) also work where noted.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market for `id`: en_us (default), en_gb, de_de, de_ch, de_at, fr_fr, sv_se, ...

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on H&M for keywords in one market (locale such as en_us, en_gb, de_de, fr_fr, sv_se), with sort, department and facet filters (one or several combined). Each product: article id, name, brand, price, regular price, currency (ISO code) and sale flag, colour (name, hex, colour groups), category, availability, new-arrival flag, markers, sizes with stock levels, other colours, link, images and `raw`. Also the departments and facets (each with its filter values and counts) for narrowing the search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `shirt`.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market and language as in hm.com links: en_us (default), en_gb, de_de, fr_fr, sv_se, ...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), newest, price_asc, price_desc.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: A department id from `departments`, e.g. men_all, ladies_all.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet value from `facets` (its `value`), e.g. colorWithNames:black_000000. Repeat `filter` (or join values with `||`) to combine up to 10 facets, e.g. `filter=colorWithNames:black_000000&filter=fits:Loose fit`.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Products per page (1-100, default 36).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Stores near a point (or a city, postcode or store name of the market's country) with each size's stock estimate for one colour, as the site's own store finder shows it: in stock, low on stock or out of stock, a quantity estimate and when it was recorded, plus the store's name, address, position and distance. The site notes that store stock is an estimate and store prices may differ.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-store-availability

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An hm.com product link (its locale sets the market). Give this or `id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The article number: 10 digits for one colour (e.g. 1313931001); 7 digits (the model) also work where noted.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market for `id`: en_us (default), en_gb, de_de, de_ch, de_at, fr_fr, sv_se, ...

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the place to search around (decimal degrees). Give lat and lon, or q.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude of the place to search around.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A city, postcode or store name of the market's country, instead of lat/lon (a city: the middle of its stores).

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius in km (1-500, default 50).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stores to return (1-100, default 20), nearest first.

parameters.name: in_stock_only
parameters.description: true: only stores with at least one size in stock.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Hoodie in Loose Fit
example.note: the site's own estimate of store stock (it says stock sells fast); store prices may differ from online prices

get.description:
Every H&M store in the locale's country: store code, name, status, phone, address, city, state, postal code, coordinates, opening hours and exceptions, and departments. Filter by name, city, state or postal code with `q`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-stores

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market as in hm.com links, e.g. en_us, en_gb, de_de (default en_us).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only stores whose name, city, state or postal code contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

stores.name: The Mall of San Juan
stores.address: The Mall of San Juan, 1000 Mall of San Juan Boulevard

stores.name: Plaza del Sol
stores.address: Plaza del Sol, 725 West Main Avenue

get.description:
The suggestions the H&M search box shows for typed text in one market: search phrases, content links and products when the site returns them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The typed text.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market: en_us (default), en_gb, de_de, de_ch, ...

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
